title: Validation Rules -- validation.yaml
description: SDD-R001 §13. Reusable engineering validation rules the owning object contributes to the Engineering Reference Library. Distinct from the Reference Validator (ENGINE-TASK-000003), which checks the authoring files themselves -- these are engineering rules the compiled object exposes for Diagram Studio / Engineering Engine validation to consume (SDD-R001 §13: "Validation shall never be duplicated inside Diagram Studio").

expression.description: A human/tool-readable boolean expression over this object's own properties (e.g. "resistance > 0"). Not executed by WORK_PACKAGE_001 -- recorded declaratively only.

applies_to.description: The property name (from properties.yaml) this rule concerns, if any.
